description:
Adds to `gf2-coding` one parallel batch decoder over the batch soft-decoder trait: a pool that owns one inner decoder per worker and is itself a batch decoder.

## Background

`gf2-coding` has a batch soft-decoder trait whose implementers decode by mutable reference and may own a workspace, so parallel decoding needs one decoder per worker. The crate's `parallel` cargo feature provides rayon. A frame's result depends on its own LLRs alone, so a partition of a batch changes no result. The decode selector `granules_per_task` of the coding tuning section gives the number of preferred-granularity groups one parallel task decodes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A public pooled batch decoder, generic over the batch soft-decoder trait, builds one inner decoder per worker of the caller's rayon pool from a factory, once, and implements the trait; it creates no nested pool.
- [hard] REQ-02: It partitions a batch into tasks of `granules_per_task` groups of the inner decoder's preferred granularity, and each task decodes on one worker's inner decoder.
- [hard] REQ-03: It passes the shared batch contract function, and its results equal the inner decoder's single-worker results bit for bit for one worker, two workers and the pool default, for several `granules_per_task` values, and for a batch size that is no multiple of the task size.
- [hard] REQ-04: Without the `parallel` feature the pooled decoder decodes sequentially on one inner decoder with identical results.
- [hard] REQ-05: Rustdoc states the worker model, the bounds it puts on the inner decoder, the workspace cost per worker and the panics.

## Notes

The pool is the one parallel batch entry of the crate; no decoder type carries a parallel entry of its own.
title: Decode batches across workers through one pooled batch decoder
